text:
Anaheim arrives winless in five (0-5-0), outscored 20-9 in that stretch, after a 4-1 loss at NJD on Thursday. The Ducks are also without Ryan Poehling, Pavel Mintyukov and Judd Caulfield. Philadelphia has won three straight, most recently 3-1 at BUF, where Cole Knuble scored his first NHL goal. The Flyers are missing Travis Konecny and Owen Tippett, and Christian Dvorak has taken over many of those minutes, now up to about 19 a night.

The chance numbers lean Anaheim's way. At five on five, ANA has taken 43% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) against 37% for PHI. Neither defence is good, as both allow around 3.5 expected goals per 60. PHI has taken 4.2 penalties a game, which keeps handing out power plays.

In net, projected starters Lukas Dostal (ANA) and Joseph Woll (PHI) are both ahead of expectation this season, at +2.9 and +4.7 goals saved above expected. Last season both finished in the red.

Watch Matvei Michkov (26% to score), who has 8 points in his last 10, and Cutter Gauthier (34%). Our under-the-radar picks are A.J. Greer, a third-liner whose shots have been dangerous lately (16% to score), and Beckett Sennecke, at 62% for a point because his line creates chances.
